topic: Is there a limit to human intelligence?
unit_of_analysis: participant, domain, task family, site, and randomized intervention arm

sampling.planning_target: approximately 1200 participants; final size set by preregistered power simulation
sampling.intervention_subset: approximately 400 participants; final size subject to feasibility and attrition

stages.name: calibration_and_pilot
stages.deliverable: high-range items, alternate forms, reliability, response-time and neural preprocessing qualification

stages.name: baseline_cross_sectional
stages.deliverable: latent domain and general factors across age and environment strata

stages.name: longitudinal_follow_up
stages.deliverable: individual trajectories, retest separation, cohort and attrition models

stages.name: randomized_plasticity_module
stages.deliverable: intent-to-treat near-transfer, far-transfer, latent-factor, and delayed follow-up contrasts

stages.name: neural_mediation_and_external_validation
stages.deliverable: predefined EEG/MRI mediation and independent-site measurement validation

decision_gates: neural claims compatible with intervention response
